```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)

library(readxl)
library(tidyverse)
```

```{r}
x <- readxl::read_xlsx("../data/Subunit OS 12122021.xlsx",
                       na = "N/A") %>%
  select(-Note)
```

filter arm
```{r}
x <- x %>% filter(Arm == "Arm")
```


```{r}
x %>%
  group_by(`N/Q`, `OS outcome`) %>%
  summarize(n = n())
```

```{r}
tallyArms <- function(df) {
  df %>%
    group_by(`N/Q`, `OS outcome`) %>%
    summarize(n = n()) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    mutate(core.out = paste(`N/Q`, `OS outcome`, sep = ".")) %>%
    select(core.out, n) %>%
    spread(key = core.out, value = n)
}

original <- tallyArms(x)
```

```{r, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
B <- 1000

# Pre-allocate memory
out <- list()

# Randomize the "OS outcome" variable and count
for(i in 1:B) {
  y <- 
    x %>%
    mutate(`OS outcome` = sample(`OS outcome`))
 
   out[[i]] <- tallyArms(y)
}

outdf <- bind_rows(out)
head(outdf)
```

print results
```{r}
testAndPrint <- function(colnames(df)){
  for (x in ids) {
    print(x)
  }
}
```
